modules.name: Pearfy game server contracts
modules.summary: Server-side tickets, bounded rooms, deterministic command processing, monotonic fixed-step input driving and single-process world primitives
capabilities: Bounded HMAC-SHA256 session tickets
Ticket expiry, revocation and session/player/protocol binding
WSS-only session offers
Bounded in-process rooms with safe paged public discovery, one-use player-bound expiring invitations and reconnect grace enforced at join
Bounded turn-based command reducer that scopes idempotency to command ID, player and exact payload bytes
Co-op objective commands bind command IDs to player, objective and state digests with a configured history ceiling
Co-op objective dependencies are validated as a bounded acyclic graph and enforced before completion
Co-op objectives support bounded monotonic progress targets with command idempotency
Co-op NPC actions use a bounded server-authored tick scheduler with ordered capped drains
Co-op reconnect grace blocks disconnected-member actions and snapshots until authenticated resume; expiry and abandonment clean private state
Co-op recovery checkpoints restore bounded private state, command dedupe, deterministic cursor and NPC schedules
Co-op sessions can expose a seeded replayable SplitMix64 sequence for application-owned decisions
Co-op public and private state share an aggregate session byte budget
Deterministic replay validation for complete command checkpoints before accepting gameplay
Bounded realtime input queue with client sequence validation and fixed-step drain
Monotonic fixed-step driver with bounded per-tick work, no catch-up bursts and fixed-cardinality overrun metrics
Three consecutive tick overruns close input admission and stop the driver while preserving queued inputs for recovery
Reducer or tick-advance failure closes input admission and the tick driver; restart requires application recovery and a new driver
Drained realtime input payloads are released immediately to reduce retained hot-path memory
Fixed-cardinality realtime overload metrics for queue pressure and accepted/rejected input counts
Single-process zone/entity registry with transfer fencing
CLI starter profiles for light, medium and high resource/transport targets
Starter templates include fixed-step rate, global/per-player queued input limits, per-tick work ceilings and a three-overrun circuit breaker
Mode profiles construct the bounded realtime simulation and fixed-step driver directly; recovered sessions can resume from the durable tick cursor
configurationChecks: Provide a server-side signing key with at least 32 bytes
Configure explicit room, queue, event, entity and state limits
Set fixed-step rate and maximum inputs per tick for the workload; monitor overruns, recover/drain before resuming closed admission, and benchmark target hardware
Use gameserver-transport for WSS/TLS gameplay and gameserver-grpc for optional gRPC/TLS control
restrictions: The core product does not include a network listener, TLS termination, gRPC/protobuf, or UDP transport; WSS is a separate optional product
Room and world state, ticket revocation, and command history are in-process; multi-instance deployment needs shared stores
Realtime primitives accept and drain inputs but deliberately do not implement genre-specific physics, anti-cheat, lag compensation, co-op mission rules, or interest management
Swift uses ARC; ownership-oriented profiles do not disable it
The high template targets UDP/binary but keeps UDP disabled until app-owned authenticated key provisioning, full socket integration, and deployed abuse/performance gates are validated
validation: coopSessionReconnect tests cover action denial, recovery, expiry, abandonment, and remaining-player behavior

Stable UUID ordering and paginated entity snapshots with byte and item response ceilings
Bounded upsert/remove deltas reconciled against a capped prior visible-ID set
Delta pages carry base/current world revisions and invalidate on concurrent mutation
World-revision cursors reject page continuation after concurrent state mutation
Monotonic entity revisions and explicit overload/configuration errors
configurationChecks: Configure cell size and maximum interest radius in application-owned integer world units
Set entity count, per-entity bytes, total state bytes, query candidate and page limits for the zone
If world revision changes during pagination, restart from offset zero using the new revision
For deltas, preserve the original prior visible-ID set and base revision until all pages are applied
Keep this query API outside the simulation tick and serialize/copy only the returned page
restrictions: Spatial units and game-specific authorization are application-defined
AOI deltas reconcile current state but are not a domain event log, transport replication protocol, physics or anti-cheat
The manager is single-process and does not persist or transfer entity authority across replicas

Binary and text WebSocket message delivery to an authoritative application callback
Connection close and listener lifecycle management

modules.name: Pearfy game server Redis recovery
modules.summary: Optional bounded Redis Streams journal and checkpoint adapter for game state recovery
capabilities: Exclusive expiring session leases with monotonically increasing fencing epochs
Atomic lease checks on event append and checkpoint writes reject expired or stale owners
Session/epoch fenced event appends
RedisDurableGameCommandSession performs write-ahead durable commit for bounded discrete commands and applies state only after append acknowledgment
Durable command recovery replays a bounded journal suffix through the deterministic reducer and verifies result-state digests
Async deterministic reducers hold per-session backpressure across actor suspension before appending the next revision
RedisDurableGameTickSession write-ahead commits bounded contiguous batches of authoritative movement, NPC, timer and inventory transitions with recorded RNG draws
Tick-batch replay validates contiguous simulation ticks and deterministic resulting-state digests before recovery completes
RedisDurableGameTickBatchQueue bounds retained batch count/bytes, coalesces writer wake-ups and preserves the head batch after append failure
RedisDurableGameTickWriteAheadBridge stages synchronously from fixed-step callbacks and commits off tick before publish/ack
The write-ahead bridge closes staging on failure, retries the same batch ID, rejects a stale receipt cursor before publication and exposes fixed-cardinality pending/commit metrics

RedisDurableGameCoopSession write-ahead commits bounded co-op lifecycle, objective transitions, server-authored NPC scheduling and seeded deterministic decisions while preserving per-player snapshot visibility
Append uncertainty is retryable by command ID; one unresolved commit per session applies explicit backpressure
State middleware checkpoints by event count or after an elapsed interval when the next update arrives
Exactly capped Redis Streams journal with explicit backpressure before uncheckpointed events are evicted
Versioned JSON checkpoint storage and event replay read
Optional periodic checkpoint scheduler captures off tick with a byte ceiling and no overlapping writes
Checksummed 256 KiB Redis checkpoint chunks with atomic fenced manifest publication and legacy single-value restore
Recovery scans journal in byte-aware bounded XRANGE pages and validates encoded records before decoding
Fresh sessions are distinguished from missing/corrupt recovery metadata; oversized or partial checkpoints fail closed
Projected state revisions are monotonic per retained key; stale revisions are rejected before append and conflicting same-revision payloads fail closed
Credentials and transport state remain outside snapshots
configurationChecks: Acquire and renew a session lease before admitting commands; use a new owner UUID for each process lifetime
Start and stop RedisGameStateRecoveryStore with application lifecycle
Configure event-count cadence and use the async interval scheduler when appropriate
Choose Redis AOF/RDB/replication settings for the required RPO
Persist only authoritative events and checkpoints; never tickets or secrets
restrictions: Redis durability and replication determine actual crash/failover RPO; Redis Streams alone do not provide zero data loss
Lease fencing rejects stale writers but does not place sessions, automatically replay state or migrate connected clients
Journal append and snapshot calls are outside the simulation tick and may add I/O latency
The direct in-memory nextDeterministicValue path is not journaled; use RedisDurableGameCoopSession.deterministicDecision for seeded decisions that must replay after restart
The scheduler does not append events, manage leases, apply replay, guarantee a final shutdown checkpoint, place sessions across nodes, or configure Redis persistence
Application capture closures must pair state with the exact durable journal sequence the checkpoint covers
validation: redisRecoveryCheckpointScheduler tests cover periodic cadence, overlap rejection, and byte ceiling
redisRecoveryMiddlewareElapsedCheckpointRoundTripsWithRedis validates elapsed cadence against Redis when configured
Redis service integration test when Redis is available
redisRecoverySurvivesProcessAndRedisRestartWithAOF in separate write/recover phases around a forced Redis restart with AOF enabled
